data.description:
## TDD Phase: UPDATE

Wire up the new script and test into the project infrastructure.

### Changes required:

**1. Register in .test-index** (at repo root):
Add entry mapping the script to its test file:
  plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh:tests/scripts/test-resolve-session-branch.sh

**2. Verify ShellCheck passes**:
Run: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh
Fix any warnings at severity=warning or above (matching per-branch-review.yml ShellCheck step settings).

**3. Verify the test file itself is ShellCheck-clean**:
Run: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-resolve-session-branch.sh

**4. Verify script is in the scripts directory listing** (sanity check):
ls plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh must succeed

**5. Verify executable bit is set**:
test -x plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh must succeed

### No caller changes in this task — callers (S2, S4, S5, S7) are other stories' responsibility per story scope definition.

### Acceptance gate:
- bash tests/scripts/test-resolve-session-branch.sh exits 0
- shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh exits 0
- .test-index contains the mapping line
data.title: Register resolve-session-branch.sh in .test-index and verify ShellCheck/lint clean
